[[Dorn Stonebreaker]] is a [[Elemental]] [[boss]] that appears during the [[Altrumm Ruins]] [[challenge mission]].

== Missions ==
* [[Echovald Forest]]
** {{NPC location|Altrumm Ruins}}

Dorn Stonebreaker appears in the starting area of the mission at 7:59 minutes left.

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Endure Pain}}
* {{skill icon|Forceful Blow}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Mighty Blow}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Raw Amber Chunks]]

== Notes ==
* The easiest way to [[capture]] this boss' [[Elite Skill]] is to start the mission and wait at the starting point until the timer reaches 8 minutes.
